messages:
Alex: Quick notes from last night's cross-family quant smoke + AWQ spot checks. TL;DR: Llama (GPTQ 4-bit) shows ~1.8% R@1 drop on NQ, Mistral (AWQ 8-bit) looks stable with ~1.5x perf win, Qwen (GPTQ 4-bit) has KV-cache drift at long context. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bakes/3398765432

Maya: nice — can you paste the top-line eval table?

Alex: sure, top-line (small sample, aggregated):
```
model      quant    NQ_exact%  PIQA_acc%  p95_latency_ms
llama-13b  gptq-4   78.2       86.4       42
mistral-7b awq-8    80.1       87.0       28
qwen-7b    gptq-4   75.0*      84.2       50
```
(* Qwen drop reproducible for seq > 2048)

Jin: what's causing the * on Qwen?

Alex: KV-cache alignment mismatch when using our default KV packing + new GPTQ kernels. Reproducer attached (small script). Short-term mitigation: serve qwen-gptq-4 only for seq<=1024 or fallback to fp16 profile for long-context routes.

Sam: do we have FP8 vs INT8 throughput numbers?

Alex: FP8 pilot (internal) shows ~+12% throughput vs INT8 for same latency target on our A100s, but we saw a small hallucination/regression signal on TriviaQA (delta ~0.7% on exact match). More tuning needed.

Leah: rollout recs?

Alex: Recommend canary 5% on Dedicated with fallback policies and eval hooks. Example snippet: 
```
rollout:
  canary: 0.05
  fallback: [mistral-awq-8, qwen-fp16]
  metrics: [nq_exact, piqa_acc, p95_latency]
```
Add continuous eval every hour for the first 24h.

Maya: :thumbsup: I'll add this as a 'quant-compat' blueprint in the Console. Can you enumerate profile ids we should register?

Alex: profile ids: ["llama-13b-gptq4-v2", "mistral-7b-awq8-v1", "qwen-7b-gptq4-kvfix-try1"]. Logs + artifacts: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-bakes/3398765432/manifest.json

BakeBot: Artifacts uploaded: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-bakes/3398765432/manifest.json

Sam: noted. I'll run an ops validation to test autoscaler interaction with AWQ latency variance tomorrow EOD (will validate burst and p95 budgets).

Jin: I'll open a PR with the KV alignment patch and link the reproducer.

Leah: thanks all — this gives enough to proceed with a cautious canary. :tada:
